label: Хотеть
description: Scaffold verb card for mixed-pattern / stem-shift practice. Expand each person into five sentences for the full 30-line deck.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular. 1. 'Хочу' shows the stem-shifted present form. 2. 'Чай' keeps the line concrete and reusable. 3. This is a high-frequency desire sentence.

Strategic focus: Second-person singular. 1. 'Хочешь' follows the same family but with a different stem shape. 2. 'Воды' gives a useful genitive-like noun form after desire. 3. This teaches verb-driven noun behavior.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular. 1. 'Хочет' is a core mixed-form pattern. 2. 'Домой' is a very common destination word. 3. The sentence feels immediately natural.
Strategic focus: First-person plural. 1. 'Хотим' closes the plural present slot. 2. 'Идти' gives the sentence motion. 3. This is a clean everyday intention phrase.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural form. 1. 'Хотите' trains the respectful form. 2. 'Знать' keeps the sentence abstract but practical. 3. This is useful in live explanations and questions.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural. 1. 'Хотят' completes the scaffold. 2. 'Помочь' makes the sentence socially useful. 3. The line is short and easy to reuse.
